title: Detiers Tier Tagger
description: This is an tiertagger for the tierlist Detiers
body: TierTagger is a mod that displays a player's PvP Tier in their nametag. TierTagger supports all 8 detiers game modes. Other tierlists (such as SubTiers) are also supported since version 2.0! The default gamemode to display is configurable. If a player is unranked in a specified game mode, TierTagger will display their highest Tier overall.
